steps.title: Cloud Resource Inventory & Metrics Aggregator
steps.description: Write a Python script that discovers simulated cloud instances, computes total memory/CPU allocations, and exports a structured JSON report.
tasks: Implement a script that reads an infrastructure list and writes `/home/student/inventory_report.json`

verification.command: python3 /home/student/inventory.py && test -f /home/student/inventory_report.json && grep -q 'total_instances' /home/student/inventory_report.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Resilient Health Probe with Exponential Backoff
steps.description: Build an HTTP probe script using `urllib.request` or `requests` that retries failing endpoints with exponential backoff and jitter.
tasks: Implement a retry loop (max 3 attempts) that waits `2 ** attempt` seconds upon failure
Log each attempt with status code and latency
Make it test connectivity to `http://localhost:80` (or fallback endpoint) and write results to `/home/student/probe.log`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/health_probe.py && python3 /home/student/health_probe.py && test -f /home/student/probe.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: High-Performance Regex Log Analyzer
steps.description: Write a Python script utilizing `re` to parse 10,000 log lines in milliseconds, aggregate top offending IPs, and compute p95 request durations.
tasks: Parse a sample log and write the top error IP to `/home/student/top_offenders.txt`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/log_analyzer.py && python3 /home/student/log_analyzer.py && test -f /home/student/top_offenders.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Incident Alert Webhook Dispatcher
steps.description: Create an alert dispatcher that formats incident payloads (JSON cards with severity, affected services, and runbook links) and dispatches to webhook endpoints.
tasks: Construct an incident payload dictionary with `severity: 'CRITICAL'`, `service: 'auth-api'`, `metric: '5xx_error_rate > 5%'`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/alert_dispatcher.py && python3 /home/student/alert_dispatcher.py && test -f /home/student/dispatched_alert.json && grep -q 'CRITICAL' /home/student/dispatched_alert.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: CLI Infrastructure Management Utility with argparse
steps.description: Develop a command-line interface utility with `argparse` supporting subcommands (`start`, `stop`, `status`, `prune`) for managing sandbox workloads.
tasks: Make `python3 /home/student/opscli.py status` print system status to stdout

verification.command: test -f /home/student/opscli.py && python3 /home/student/opscli.py status | grep -iE 'status|ok|running|system' && echo PASS || echo FAIL
